title: 6/18 a correct MDP skip day produced no signal (no log line, DM or dashboard state) — indistinguishable from a hang
tier_reason: the skip itself was correct (no delivery or state impact); the defect was a missing outcome signal that left the operator unable to tell a skip from a hang

contract.text: A game day on which the MDP declines to pick surfaces that outcome explicitly (log line, one-time skip DM in dm mode, dashboard banner) rather than returning silently.

mechanism.text: when every candidate was below the MDP pick bar, run_single_check computed predictions and returned with pick_result None; run_day had no skip branch and web.py no skip state, so the day produced no log line, DM or dashboard signal

residual.text: The skip notice is tentative: an early cycle can still flip to a pick; the first live flip (7/01–7/02) left contradictory skip/pick dashboard states until 258aaa4/2c62d72.

watchdog.trigger: on a game day, by the earliest remaining game's cutoff (first pitch − 5 min) neither a scoreable commit nor a recorded deliberate skip (decision action=skip, source=mdp) with its skip notice exists
watchdog.recovery_assertion: the date carries either a scoreable commit or a final skip record whose notice was delivered (dm mode) or logged (private mode), and the dashboard shows the same outcome

evidence.what: the 2026-06-18 'why no suggestion?' incident: the best candidate was below the pick bar and correctly skipped, but the daemon returned silently — no DM, no log line, no dashboard signal; a legitimate skip was indistinguishable from a hang
